title: Mathematician sees DMT entities solving the four color theorem instantly

tellings.quote: right. Uh, and yet these entities they they [snorts] do it instantaneously like less than a second and they do it repeatedly.

plain: A mathematician who took DMT, a powerful psychedelic drug, says he saw beings in that state solve the four color theorem, a famous math problem about coloring maps, "instantaneously like less than a second", and do it over and over. The neuroscientist Andrew Gallimore tells this on the show, passing on what a mathematician he calls Andress told him. Gallimore offers it as a sign that the beings people meet on DMT seem to have minds far beyond ours.
